name: Santa Fe
tagline: Art Capital of the Southwest with Adobe Charm and High Desert Beauty
description: Santa Fe is unlike any other American city. The oldest state capital in the US blends centuries of Native American, Spanish, and Anglo cultures into a world-renowned art scene, distinctive adobe architecture, and a food culture built around New Mexican chile. At 7,000 feet elevation, summers are cool and winters bring crisp mountain air and skiing. Housing costs are above average for New Mexico but well below coastal cities, making it a compelling FIRE choice for those who value culture and natural beauty over nightlife and big-city bustle.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for US citizens
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate to Good – low violent crime
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Santa Fe Regional (SAF) or Albuquerque International Sunport (ABQ, 65 mi)
quickFacts.climate: High desert arid with cool summers and cold winters

housing.description: Cheapest acceptable studio or small casita on the south side

dining.description: Home cooking with Hatch chile; casual New Mexican spots out a couple of times a week

healthcare.description: ACA marketplace Silver plan via New Mexico's exchange, subsidized if MAGI stays under the 2026 ~$62,600 400%-FPL cliff; New Mexico uniquely backfilled the lost federal subsidy for 2026. Assumes an early retiree (45–55) — older retirees budget more

transportation.description: An older paid-off car with insurance and gas — essential here (limited Santa Fe Trails and Rail Runner transit)

entertainment.description: Free Friday gallery walks on Canyon Road, hiking the Sangre de Cristos, plaza people-watching

1M.lifestyle: A cheapest-acceptable studio or small casita on the south side, where housing takes a large share of the budget — Santa Fe's resort-and-art-market premium shows up most in rent. Cooking at home with Hatch chile is the norm, with casual New Mexican meals out a couple of times a week. Free Friday gallery walks on Canyon Road, hiking the Sangre de Cristos, and the dry climate's low utility bills all help. The ACA Silver premium stays low if MAGI is managed under the 2026 ~$62,600 cliff — and New Mexico's unique state backfill softens the picture.

housing.description: A decent 1BR near the Railyard or midtown

dining.description: Regular meals at mid-range rooms like The Shed, Tomasita's, and Paloma

healthcare.description: A Silver plan; net cost low if MAGI is managed under the cliff (NM's state backfill helps)

transportation.description: A reliable SUV for mountain roads, full coverage

entertainment.description: Santa Fe Opera tickets, a Ski Santa Fe pass, art classes, Indian Market weekend

2M.lifestyle: A charming adobe near the Railyard or on the historic east side, dining out several times a week at rooms like The Shed and Tomasita's, and Santa Fe Opera tickets in summer. A Ski Santa Fe pass covers winter, and weekend trips to Taos or Bandelier add variety. Good coverage and a reliable SUV for mountain roads are covered with room to spare.

dining.description: Frequent dining at Geronimo, Terra, and Sazon; wine dinners

3M.lifestyle: A custom adobe on the historic east side or in the foothills with mountain views and kiva fireplaces, regular dinners at Geronimo and Terra, premium opera seats, and a growing collection from Canyon Road galleries. A late-model 4WD SUV handles mountain roads, healthcare is padded near the ~$62,600 ACA cliff, and there is margin for regular travel. A genuinely affluent Santa Fe life.

dining.description: Fine dining at Geronimo and Sazon plus private-chef entertaining and a curated wine cellar

5M.lifestyle: A luxury home on Museum Hill, a Las Campanas property, or a historic Canyon Road compound, with cleaning a couple of times a week and unsubsidized concierge healthcare. Patron-level opera and museum memberships, regular art purchases, and business-class travel all fit. Santa Fe's art market and cultural scene offer real ways to spend meaningfully at this level.

dining.description: A private chef specializing in New Mexican cuisine plus exclusive dining events

healthcare.description: A top-tier unsubsidized plan plus concierge and holistic care

transportation.description: Multiple luxury vehicles, private car service, charter flights from Santa Fe Regional

entertainment.description: Major philanthropic arts patronage, private gallery events, international art-fair travel

domesticHelp.description: Full-time housekeeper, personal assistant, and a property/grounds team

luxuryExtras.description: Museum-level art acquisitions, first-class international travel, a Taos ranch property

10M.lifestyle: A sprawling Las Campanas estate or a historic Canyon Road compound, full-time domestic staff, and a private chef several days a week specializing in New Mexican cuisine. First-class travel, top-tier concierge medicine, and museum-level art acquisitions are all comfortable, and a Taos ranch property is within reach. Santa Fe's small-city costs mean roughly $224k a year buys premium living with healthy margins — the batch's most expensive top tier, driven by its rarefied luxury real estate.
